test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average score of a cricketer in his first 7 innings is 28 runs. His average score in the next 3 innings is 32 runs. Determine the score he should get in his 11th inning so that his overall average score becomes 33 runs,
solution:
**Given:**

avg. score in first 7 innings= 28

avg. score in next 3 innings= 32

avg. score in 11 innings= 33

**formula used :**

average= total\:sumover number\:of\:values

**calculations:**

average score in 7 innings= 28

total runs in 7 innings= 7×28= 196

average score in next 3 innings= 32

total runs in 3 innings= 3×32=96

total runs in 10 innings= 196+ 96= 292

average score in 11 innings= 33

total runs in 11 innings = 11×33= 363

total run scored in 11th inning= 363- 292= 71

**Therefore, the total runs scored in 11th inning is 71 runs.**
